explanation: Several Period 1 documents say Nikatum Gamevet is based in Tapdiho. The Period 3 memo lists locations for other staff but not for him, so I found no record of a move. This answer rests on the Period 1 records.
Memory lists Nikatum Gamevet as based_in Kunlapet.
The current relation graph says Nikatum Gamevet is based in Kunlapet. The Period 1 documents said Tapdiho, so the location has changed since then.

Corran Bridge was "proposed" in Period 1 and "active" in Period 2. Period 3 reports don't state a new status. They show it still being worked on: Valode Zihuki leads it, and the Ashen Initiative depends on it. So "active" is the latest recorded status.
Memory lists the Corran Bridge project's status as "active".
Corran Bridge's current status relation in memory is "active". It was "proposed" in Period 1 and has since changed.

The latest (Period 3) team memo says Saru Surobov reports to Bulve Dutubus. Earlier periods had Saru reporting to Nikatum Gamevet. The same memo also says Bulve Dutubus reports to Saru Surobov, which contradicts it, and a second Period 3 record agrees with that second line. I couldn't resolve the conflict, so Bulve Dutubus is my best answer.
Memory shows Saru Surobov reports_to Bulve Dutubus.

The Period 3 memo (the latest) and the current relation both say Saru Surobov reports to Bulve Dutubus. The memo also says Bulve reports to Saru, so the records are circular. In Period 2, Saru reported to Nikatum Gamevet, but that is out of date.
Period 3 documents (the latest) say Review 5259 is located in Kunlapet. It was held in Tapdiho in Period 2, so it has moved since then.
Review 5259 is located_at Kunlapet.
Period 3 records state that Review 5259 is located in Kunlapet. Period 2 minutes said it was held in Tapdiho, so the location changed. The Period 3 record is the latest one.

The Period 2 records say Gelpenbe Ketehot leads project Ferrix Array. I found no later record that names a different leader or says he stopped leading it. The Period 3 status report for Ferrix Array doesn't name a leader. It only lists Valode Zihuki as leading Corran Bridge.
Memory shows Gelpenbe Ketehot leads Ferrix Array.
Memory shows Gelpenbe Ketehot leads Ferrix Array.

The memory doesn't name a lead for Lumen Forge. The Period 3 status report lists two current team members: Befkon Mehamhe and Pihnal Batun. Befkon Mehamhe has the Bio-Fabrication skill, according to the Period 1 records and the Review 7746 minutes. Pihnal Batun is only recorded with Signal Processing. Befkon leads Ashen Initiative, not Lumen Forge, so I counted Befkon as a regular member. Valode Zihuki and Kata Saho worked on Lumen Forge in Period 2, but I found no Period 3 record of them on it, so I left them out.

Four people work at Lumen Forge: Pihnal Batun, Befkon Mehamhe, Kata Saho and Valode Zihuki. Only Befkon Mehamhe and Kata Saho have Bio-Fabrication. Memory has no "leads" relation for Lumen Forge, so I couldn't identify its lead. Neither of these two is recorded as leading it: Befkon leads Ashen Initiative and Kata leads Corran Bridge. I have therefore listed both.

Befkon Mehamhe, Kata Saho, Pihnal Batun and Valode Zihuki work at Lumen Forge. Only Befkon Mehamhe and Kata Saho have the Bio-Fabrication skill. The memory records no lead for Lumen Forge. Befkon leads Ashen Initiative and Kata leads Corran Bridge, so I couldn't exclude either of them as the project's lead. I'm therefore listing both.

This is a best guess, because the records don't give a complete current roster for Ferrix Array.

- Befkon Mehamhe worked on Ferrix Array in Period 2 and has the Thermal Systems skill, recorded in Period 1.
- Gelpenbe Ketehot is the Ferrix Array lead in the Period 2 reports, and the only other person recorded with Thermal Systems (Period 2). The question excludes the lead.
- The only other person named on Ferrix Array in Period 3 is Nikatum Gamevet. Nikatum's recorded skill is Signal Processing, not Thermal Systems.
- A Period 3 report puts Befkon on Lumen Forge. It doesn't say Befkon left Ferrix Array, so I've kept Befkon on the team.
- The Period 3 memos don't name a new Ferrix Array lead, so I've assumed Gelpenbe is still the lead.
Gelpenbe Ketehot leads Ferrix Array. The only other person who works there and has Thermal Systems is Befkon Mehamhe. Nikatum Gamevet also works there but doesn't have the skill.

Gelpenbe Ketehot leads Ferrix Array. The people working at Ferrix Array are Befkon Mehamhe and Nikatum Gamevet. Of these, only Befkon Mehamhe has the Thermal Systems skill. Gelpenbe Ketehot also has it, but is the project lead, so is excluded.

Ferrix Array's current workers are Befkon Mehamhe and Nikatum Gamevet. Only Nikatum Gamevet has the Signal Processing skill. Gelpenbe Ketehot also has the skill but leads the project, so is excluded.

Corran Bridge requires Adaptive Materials and Signal Processing. Gelpenbe Ketehot is the only person I found with Adaptive Materials (Period 3), and also has Signal Processing (Periods 1–2 records). Gelpenbe leads Ferrix Array, which doesn't count toward workload. I found no other project work for Gelpenbe, so the two-project limit is met. I found no sponsor recorded for Corran Bridge, so I treated nobody as having a conflict of interest. Gelpenbe's lead of Ferrix Array (sponsored by Zehu Systems in Period 2) would be a conflict only if Corran Bridge were also sponsored by Zehu Systems. That would change this answer. Gelpenbe alone covers both required skills, so no one else is needed.

Corran Bridge requires Adaptive Materials and Signal Processing. Gelpenbe Ketehot is the only person with Adaptive Materials, and also has Signal Processing, so one person covers both skills. Gelpenbe works on no active projects and only leads Ferrix Array, which is sponsored by Zehu Systems. I found no sponsor listed for Corran Bridge, so there is no shared sponsor and no conflict of interest. Gelpenbe alone is therefore a valid team. Corran Bridge requires Adaptive Materials and Signal Processing. Gelpenbe Ketehot is the only person with Adaptive Materials, and also has Signal Processing, so one person covers both skills. Gelpenbe works on no projects, only leading Ferrix Array, and leading doesn't count towards the limit. The memory shows no sponsor for Corran Bridge, so Gelpenbe has no sponsor conflict. The only skill I found that Ashen Initiative requires is Signal Processing. Zehu Systems sponsors Ashen Initiative, and also sponsors Lumen Forge and Ferrix Array.

Five people have the skill: Valode Zihuki, Gelpenbe Ketehot, Kata Saho, Pihnal Batun and Nikatum Gamevet.

- **Gelpenbe Ketehot:** has a conflict of interest. They lead Ferrix Array, which Zehu Systems sponsors. I assumed Ferrix Array is still active and still Zehu-sponsored, because the latest Zehu sponsorship record I found for it is from Period 2.
- **Pihnal Batun:** the cleanest fit. They work on only one project (Lumen Forge) and lead none, so they are under the limit of 2 and have no conflict.

One person covers the single required skill, so a team of one meets the "four or fewer" limit. I picked Pihnal Batun as the safest choice. Valode Zihuki and Nikatum Gamevet also look eligible. I did not rule out Kata Saho, but I did not check her workload or conflicts.

I found no sponsor record for Corran Bridge, so I treated Valode Zihuki's leadership of it as not conflicting.

Ashen Initiative requires only Signal Processing. Five people have it. Gelpenbe Ketehot is out because they lead Ferrix Array, which shares the sponsor Zehu Systems. Nikatum Gamevet and Valode Zihuki each work on 3 active projects, so they are out too. Kata Saho and Pihnal Batun both qualify: each works on only Lumen Forge and leads Corran Bridge, which has no sponsor listed. I picked Kata Saho. Pihnal Batun would also be a valid choice.

Ashen Initiative requires only Signal Processing. Five people have that skill. Gelpenbe Ketehot leads Ferrix Array, which is active and sponsored by Zehu Systems like Ashen, so he has a conflict of interest. Nikatum Gamevet works on three active projects: Ashen, Corran Bridge and Ferrix Array. That is more than 2, so he is out. Valode Zihuki has the skill and is already on Ashen. Valode also works on Lumen Forge, which makes 2 active projects. Leading Corran Bridge doesn't count towards that, and Corran Bridge has no recorded sponsor, so it causes no conflict. Valode alone covers the requirement. Kata Saho and Pihnal Batun would also be eligible if you want more people, but the single skill doesn't need them.

Gelpenbe Ketehot has Thermal Systems and leads only Ferrix Array itself, so there is no conflict. Kata Saho has Bio-Fabrication and works on only one project, Lumen Forge. Together they cover both required skills. Saru Surobov also has Bio-Fabrication, but I found no project assignments for Saru, so I couldn't check the two-project limit. I left Saru out because a two-person team already covers both skills.
